title: Danish Palaces Egg, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Coin from the latest Fabergé series for 2025 Created for admirers of beauty and unique collections Design inspired by the historical egg with danish palace views Precision craftsmanship rooted in fine jewelled artistry This exceptional coin features the renowned egg created by Carl Fabergé in 1890 to celebrate the birthday of Queen Dagmar. The original held miniature watercolors of Danish royal residences — symbolically depicted here around the composition. The design includes golden bands and crystal, reflecting the richly decorated character of the original. A collector’s piece crafted for those who value art, history, and masterful craftsmanship.
